_fieldNotes.hooks: Names of functions on window[global]. null = optional. ready: resolves when textures are loaded; if null, wait for document.fonts.ready plus one renderAt(0). injectDefect(name): optional, lets the golden set break the real scene (e.g. 'floating-prop', 'hovering-meeple', 'pop-in'). Gameplay hooks: playAt(t) renders live play at play-clock time t with every tween (tile drop, meeple drop, highlights, score popups, view morph) driven by t; botMove() lets the deterministic bot choose and apply its next move including a meeple, animated on the play clock; showLegalMoves(on) toggles placement highlights; setView(mode, instant?) switches view. loadFixture('fixture-midgame') must give a board where the scripted bot moves complete at least one road and one city.
_fieldNotes.frameDiff: Spike = per-cell (grid x grid) or second-order changed-pixel fraction > spikeFactor x its segment median.
_fieldNotes.pageShots: Full-page screenshots (HUD included) at renderAt(t) in the given view. Use {view} in rubric shot names to pair items with these.
_fieldNotes.references: Every image any rubric item may cite. Startup fails if one is missing.
_fieldNotes.protectedPaths: The patcher may edit anything else in the worktree, except baseline tests (files under tests/ tracked at the run's start commit).
_fieldNotes.regressionTestDir: Where the patcher adds new tests. These run in acceptance but never count as passing a rubric item.
_fieldNotes.patcher: Tool-call and wall-clock caps per iteration; escalatedMaxToolCalls applies to the iteration after a lead_architect escalation.
_fieldNotes.limits: plateauIterations: non-improving iterations in a row before escalating to lead_architect. budgetUsd is the real cap.
_fieldNotes.timeline.motionSegments: Cinematic segments sent to judge_a as clipped videos. Gameplay videos are always sent too.
_fieldNotes.views: Every view the game has. Each iteration captures and judges all of them (hard rule 9).
_fieldNotes.gameplay: Scripted play, captured full-page at fps on the play clock. Steps: {at, call, args} invokes a hook; {at, click} is a real Playwright click on a selector. perView scripts run once per view; others once from startView. label is shown to judges as the expected event.
